layman_headline: Market fear is running high and none of the trade setups look clean enough to risk real money on.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market mood is in 'Fear' territory at 27 out of 100 and has been worsening all week. Bitcoin is drifting slightly lower, down about 2% over the past week, and most altcoins are in confirmed downtrends with bearish chart patterns. While a couple of coins like TRUMP and PENGU have oversold RSI readings that could trigger a bounce, their charts are ugly — prices are below all moving averages and showing bearish reversal patterns. KAITO is the only coin with bullish momentum, but its RSI at 87 screams overbought and chasing it here would be reckless.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market is fearful and trending down. There's no rush to buy when most charts look bearish — better setups will come when the fear starts to lift or when oversold coins show actual reversal confirmation rather than just falling knives.
expert_reasoning: Applying validated rules: Fear & Greed at 27 is just above the 25 threshold where Rule #3 says the outlook is genuinely ambiguous. The worsening trend (week avg 27.9, trending down) suggests we could breach 25 soon. Per signal credibility intelligence, RSI is my most reliable indicator (71% win rate), and it tells two contradictory stories — KAITO at 87 is a strong sell signal, while TRUMP at 27 and PENGU at 28 are in bounce territory. However, the chart bias scores for TRUMP (-0.70) and PENGU (-1.70) are deeply bearish, and both are below all moving averages with no bullish candlestick reversal patterns. An oversold RSI in a downtrend without reversal confirmation is a falling knife, not a trade setup. The macro news backdrop is negative with the cold-wallet hack creating security fears and Trump Media liquidating BTC. I'll wait for either: (1) RSI oversold + bullish reversal candle + support hold, or (2) Fear & Greed stabilization/uptick.
risk_factors: Cold-wallet hack spreading to 4,500 addresses could escalate further and trigger broader sell-off
Fear & Greed trending toward extreme fear (sub-25) could lead to capitulation selling
Trump Media selling down BTC holdings adds sustained sell pressure on the market's primary asset
watch_list: Fear & Greed Index — if it drops below 25, expect further downside; if it bounces above 30, conditions improve
TRUMP and PENGU RSI — watch for bullish reversal candles (hammer, morning star) while RSI stays under 30 for a potential bounce trade
Cold-wallet hack news — if losses expand beyond $89M or more wallets are affected, risk-off sentiment will intensify
market_context: The crypto market is in a fear-driven drift lower with BTC at $63,188 and most altcoins in confirmed downtrends. Negative news catalysts (cold-wallet hack, BTC selling by Trump Media, Russia mining ban expansion) are outweighing any bullish narratives, and there's no clear bottom signal yet.
context_banner: Fear dominates with no clean setups — patience is the highest-conviction trade right now.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 27 with a worsening weekly trend indicates sustained bearish sentiment; per validated rules, near the 25 threshold where short-term direction is genuinely ambiguous.
KAITO RSI at 87 (overbought, don't chase) and TRUMP/PENGU RSI at 27-28 (oversold but unconfirmed reversal) — RSI is the most reliable signal at 71% win rate but gives no actionable entry today.
Bitcoin cold-wallet attack spreading to 4,500 addresses with $89M in losses creates security fear and risk-off sentiment across the market.
Trump Media sold another 2,628 BTC reducing holdings to 4,261 BTC — a notable institutional seller adding downward pressure.
No volume breakout signals detected across candidates; ADA's 9% daily pump and 13.9% weekly gain with $540M volume is notable but wasn't on the swing candidate list for full analysis.
